objective: Coordinator's go-ahead (17 November 2026), DISTANCE-DIM-20261117-001's first direction: which three-place knot laws placed on the six-regular weave are disordered (their counts' log a linear ruler at large scale), critical, or frozen; whether each law's information is pairwise; and so for which laws the distance that carries the information also steps outward without skipping on the weave's own meeting pattern. Serves G1 and G16; tests A97.
status: Complete 2026-11-17 (Successful; refereed R1, confirmed with fixes): on the six-regular weave no tested knot law has a pair-count distance that both carries its information and is a ruler. Only the NAE class is pairwise (proved); every law with one NAE-class knot on all up knots and one on all down knots (16) is critical or frozen; OR and hard hexagons give rulers in envelope but need counts of three. Referee probes: a 10% signed mix and one 2 x 2 periodic law look disordered with every knot pairwise, so the obstruction holds for one-knot-per-orientation laws only. 6 of 8 frozen predictions held.
stop_rule: One proof and one frozen computation with its read-out; A97 status; referee hand-off; report.
title: Which knot laws on the weave give a ruler from their counts
